newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian retail trade rises 7.9 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Romanian retail trade rises 7.9 pct in 1996.

text.p: Romania's 1996 retail sales rose 7.9 percent to 22.58 trillion lei ($3.3 billion) at the end of December, a National Statistics Board (CNS) report showed on Thursday.
Retail sales jumped 19 percent in the first half of 1996, but surging inflation slowed the growth in the last months of the year, the report said.
Inflation soared in the 1996 second half, with December hitting 10.3 percent. Year-on-year December inflation was 56.9 percent, up from 27.8 percent in 1995.
Non-food products accounted for 59.3 percent of 1996 retail sales, up from 58.6 percent the previous year.
The private sector took some 78.5 percent of last year's retail sales, up from 76.4 percent in 1995.
